correctness.rationale: Full six-state half-filled Ising generator at per-edge attempt rate one has three global-reversal pairs with exact stationary probabilities for each microstate a=(p+q)/(2D), b=q(p+q)/(2D), c=q/D, D=p(1+q)+3q+q². Independent symbolic construction of all original six microscopic transition rates verified each master equation and both hot/cold correlation formulas (not only aggregated chain). Hot/opposite correlation is 4a−1, other cold 4c−1, yielding exact strict sign boundary and feasibility q<sqrt2−1. Hot uphill net flux 2cp−2b=q(p−q)/D gives heat 4J times this and entropy rate q(p−q)log(p/q)/D. For p=1, derivative A'=(1−2q−5q²)/(1+4q+q²)^2, and strictly increasing right side of the stationary equation establishes unique maximum q≈0.13001877. All q>0 and T_h finite/infinite boundaries covered; no cold zero-temperature claim.
